title: AlgoTime Fall 2026
description: Welcome to Algotime Fall 2026! Practice these key algorithm problems to sharpen your skills.

units.title: Week 1
units.description: Week 1 — Ransom Note, Two Sum, Group Anagrams, Candy Crush, Trapping Rain Water, Word Ladder.

units.title: Week 2
units.description: Week 2 — Reverse Linked List, Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock, Add Two Numbers, Number of Islands, Reverse Nodes in K-Group, Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum.

units.title: Week 3
units.description: Week 3 — Valid Parentheses, Climbing Stairs, House Robber, Course Schedule, Rank Transform of a Matrix, N-Queens.

units.title: Week 4
units.description: Week 4 — hashing, stacks & sliding windows (two easy, two medium, two hard). Contains Duplicate (e.g. [1,2,3,1] → true), Roman to Integer ("MCMXCIV" → 1994), Daily Temperatures ([73,74,75,71,69,72,76,73] → [1,1,4,2,1,1,0,0]), Merge Intervals ([[1,3],[2,6],[8,10]] → [[1,6],[8,10]]), Minimum Window Substring ("ADOBECODEBANC","ABC" → "BANC"), Largest Rectangle in Histogram ([2,1,5,6,2,3] → 10).

units.title: Week 5
units.description: Week 5 — two pointers, binary search & dynamic programming (two easy, two medium, two hard). Majority Element ([2,2,1,1,1,2,2] → 2), First Unique Character ("leetcode" → 0), Product of Array Except Self ([1,2,3,4] → [24,12,8,6]), Search in Rotated Sorted Array ([4,5,6,7,0,1,2],0 → 4), Sliding Window Maximum ([1,3,-1,-3,5,3,6,7],3 → [3,3,5,5,6,7]), Edit Distance ("horse","ros" → 3).
